messages.en: What are you doing~?
Badge War comes out today, right?
I'm looking forward to it too.
Seriously ㅋㅎㅋㄹㅋㄹㅋㄹㅋ
I'm curious about everyone's reactions…
Ha…
We went way too hard,
so I'm worried again.
ㅋㄹㅋㄹㅋㄹㄹㅋ
This is the video I promise I'd send you before.

messages.ko: 찍은거 더 많은데 너무 밤티라 그냥 컷했어
messages.en: I filmed a lot more, but it looked too rough, so I just cut it.
This will probably be my last blonde video!!!
Probably.
I haven't dyed it yet,
but I will soon.
I like the grown-out roots too, they have their own vibe ㅜㅡ
They're really hard to maintain.
When my roots grow out, you can see the bangs piece too,
and people tease me asking why I put a wig on my bangs,
or whether I got hair loss on my bangs.

messages.ko: 뿌염 안한 버전 앞머리피스는 따로 없나
messages.en: Isn't there a bangs piece for the version where you don't touch up the roots?
So my stylist and I ㅋㄹㅋㄹㅋㄹㅋ
every time my roots grew out,
we would color the roots of the piece black ㅋㄹㅋㄹㅋㄹㅋ
Are you performing Lemonade?? ㅠㅠㅠㅠㅠㅠㅠㅠㅠㅠㅠ
I'm not.
The members have been working really hard preparing for it, though.
Lemonade, Lemonade~~~ Oh my God, stop!
Ah, but right now, out of the 24 members,
I'm the only one with light-colored hair,
so part of me doesn't want to lose this specialness.
But I'll dye it anyway~ I don't know~
You're special even without that hair.
Aww..
Alright,
I'll recommend something for dinner today.
Dakgalbi~?
Vegetable gopchang~?
I can't eat after 7 PM.
I'm seriously dieting.
Let's get rid of the pig label.
Sob ㅜㅜㅠㅠ

messages.ko: 근데 돼지라는건 귀여운사람함테만 붙는 애칭이라거 해서
messages.en: But I heard that “pig” is a nickname you only give to someone who's cute,
Hehehe
I love you, piggy 🫰💕
Mmm..

messages.ko: 아니 내가 다이어트를 찐으로 결심한 이유는
messages.en: No, the reason I seriously decided to diet is
when I was trying to buy clothes,
everything looked bulky when I put it on,
like, that's how it was.
This is serious.
I thought I wouldn't look good in stage outfits later either,
so that's why I decided to do it.
If I practice choreography hard,
it'll basically count as cardio anyway.
ㅋ Exercise is a luxury.

messages.ko: 너무 말라질까봐 건강 나빠질까봐 걱정은 안해도 괜찮앙
messages.en: You don't have to worry about me getting too skinny or my health getting worse.
ㅠㅠㅠㅠ

messages.ko: 근데 ㄷ지금도 몸은 말라보여 얼굴만 동그라미같고
messages.en: But you already look skinny, it's just your face that looks round.
I look like a Chupa Chups.
That sounds even worse..
You'll eat a lot before 7, right?
ㅋㄹㅋㄹㅋㄹㅋㄹㅋㄹㄹㅋ
Am I supposed to eat everything I want before 7? ㅋㄹㅋㄹㅋㄹㅋㄹ
Order about four dishes,
then start eating before 7,
and just eat away~
I'm going to work out now.
Pretty cool, right?
A girl who takes care of herself~~
Didn't you say exercise was a luxury;;
You have to indulge in luxury when you can~ ㅋㅎㅋㄹㅋㄹ
I'm off~
See you as a hot girl~
I love you😍😍
